subject: general
question: Who took part in the 69th Session of the United Nations Commission on the Status of Women (UNCSW), held at the UN Headquarters in New York?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Annpurna Devi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Annpurna Devi, Union Minister of State for Education, represented India at the 69th Session of the United Nations Commission on the Status of Women (UNCSW).
 
• The session was held at the United Nations Headquarters in New York in March 2023.
 
• The theme for the 69th Session of UNCSW was "Innovation and technological change, and education in the digital age for achieving gender equality and the empowerment of all women and girls."
 
• Annpurna Devi emphasized India's commitment to gender equality and empowerment through technology and innovation.
 
• The session focused on global discussions regarding the role of technology in bridging gender gaps and promoting inclusivity in education and innovation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **United Nations Commission on the Status of Women (UNCSW):**

 
 
• UNCSW is a functional commission of the United Nations Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC).
 
• Its primary focus is on advancing gender equality and the empowerment of women globally.
 
• It convenes annually at the UN Headquarters in New York to discuss progress, challenges, and strategies related to women's rights.
 
 
 
• **India's Efforts in Digital Education:**
 
 
• India has launched several initiatives like PM eVIDYA, DIKSHA (Digital Infrastructure for Knowledge Sharing), and SWAYAM to enhance digital education.
 
• These programs aim to provide inclusive and equitable access to education, especially for marginalized groups.
 
 
 
• **Role of Technology in Gender Equality:**
 
 
• Technology and innovation play a crucial role in bridging the digital divide and promoting women's participation in education and workforce.
 
• Global discussions focus on ensuring equal access to digital resources and addressing challenges such as online safety and digital literacy.
 
 
 
• **India's Global Representation:**
 
 
• India actively participates in global forums like UNCSW to showcase its efforts in gender equality and sustainable development.
 
• Such participation reflects India's commitment to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly SDG 5 (Gender Equality).
